jobs.description:
Job Description
  
  

The Opportunity
  
Join a global biopharma company with a 130\-year legacy and mission to achieve new milestones in healthcare. Be part of technology driven, data\-led organization supporting a diversified portfolio of medicines, vaccines and animal health products. Work alongside passionate teams that use data, analytics and insights to drive decisions, and tackle some of the world’s greatest health threats.
  
Our Technology Centers are globally distributed hubs that enable our digital transformation and business outcomes across IT. Each Tech Center is supported by a focused group of leaders who invest in the well\-being of our people and work together across locations to optimize global connections and continuously share and improve best practices.
  
  

This role is based at our Hyderabad Tech Center and follows a hybrid working model (at least 3 days onsite, 2 days remote). Candidates are expected to reside within commuting distance of the Hyderabad office.
  
  

Role Overview
  
As a Full\-Stack Software Engineer, you will design, develop, deploy, and support secure, scalable software solutions across the user interface, API, data, cloud, and AI layers. You will collaborate with engineers, architects, product managers, and delivery teams to build high\-quality applications that solve business problems.
  
You will contribute to GenAI and Agentic AI solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, enterprise integrations, and cloud\-native technologies. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy building modern applications, solving complex problems, and continuously learning emerging technologies.
  
  

What will you do in this role
  
* Develop and maintain complex full\-stack applications and software configurations in collaboration with global cross\-functional teams.
* Develop responsive, accessible user interfaces using modern web technologies such as React, Angular, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
* Design and implement secure APIs, microservices, and backend services using Python, Node.js, Java, .NET, or equivalent technologies.
* Build GenAI\-enabled applications leveraging LLMs, prompt engineering, semantic search, AI agents, enterprise knowledge sources, and orchestration frameworks
* Design, develop, and optimize Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines including ingestion, chunking, embeddings, retrieval, reranking, grounding, and evaluation.
* Develop agentic workflows using reasoning, planning, tool calling, workflow orchestration, memory patterns, and human\-in\-the\-loop interactions.
* Integrate AI services with enterprise applications, APIs, authentication systems, knowledge repositories, and business workflows.
* Work with structured and unstructured data using relational databases, vector databases, search platforms, and cloud\-native data services.
* Design and execute automated and manual testing strategies covering application functionality, integrations, APIs, and AI solution quality.
* Build, deploy, monitor, and support applications on AWS/GCP/Azure using cloud\-native engineering practices.
* Contribute to AI evaluation, monitoring, prompt management, model performance measurement, and continuous improvement of production AI systems.
* Apply secure software engineering principles including authentication, authorization, API security, encryption, secrets management, and data protection.
* Lead Agile product delivery, sprint planning, solution design discussions, and continuous improvement activities within a matrixed global organization.
* Regularly mentor colleagues, provide help with complex technical problems, defining engineering standards, and identifying reusable code and modules.
* Contribute to the development of solution architectures in business, infrastructure, or functional areas.
* Identify and evaluate alternative architectures and the trade\-offs in cost, performance and scalability.
* Partner with global cross\-functional teams to plan, execute and release in an Agile setup and deliver within matrix organization.


What should you have
  
* Bachelors’ degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field
* 7\-11 years of hands\-on experience working in full\-stack development
* Experience building cloud\-native applications and deploying solutions into production environments.
* Passion for technology innovation, AI\-enabled engineering, and continuous learning.


Primary skills (must\-have)
  
* Strong programming skills in Python and at least one additional technology stack such as TypeScript/Node.js, Java, or .NET.
* Strong full\-stack software engineering experience across frontend, backend, APIs, integrations, databases, cloud\-native architectures, and enterprise application development using technologies such as React, Angular, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, and semantic search.
* Experience building or integrating AI\-powered applications, intelligent assistants, agentic workflows, AI orchestration frameworks.
* Experience with GenAI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar technologies.
* Experience with vector databases and search technologies such as OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, or FAISS.
* Experience with cloud platforms, preferably AWS and/or Azure/GCP, including microservices, containers, serverless architectures, and managed services.
* Experience with DevSecOps practices including Git, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, monitoring, observability, and automated testing.
* Experience implementing LLMOps practices including AI monitoring, model evaluation, prompt management, versioning, and production observability.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills with a product and customer\-centric mindset.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineering Lead
jobs.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

  

We are seeking a hands\-on Senior Full Stack AEM Engineer to design scalable Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) solutions and deliver high\-performance digital experiences across enterprise healthcare platforms. In this role, you will build reusable components, guide technical decisions, implement modern frontend experiences (React, TypeScript, Next.js), and leverage backend Java/OSGi services. Supporting large\-scale healthcare digital platforms, you will drive headless content delivery, component authoring, accessibility, SEO, Core Web Vitals, and leverage enterprise\-approved AI tools and technologies to streamline workflows and accelerate solution delivery in an Agile environment.

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Lead the design and development of reusable AEM components, templates, dialogs, workflows, client libraries, and content authoring capabilities
* Build robust backend services using Java, Sling Models, OSGi components, servlets, schedulers, JCR/Oak, Maven, and REST APIs.  

Implement modern frontend experiences using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and SCSS
* Integrate React components into AEM pages using modern frontend build patterns and scalable component architecture.  

Design and implement Headless AEM solutions using Content Fragments, Content Fragment Models, GraphQL APIs, and Experience Fragments
* Define integration patterns between AEM\-rendered content, React/Next.js applications, APIs, third\-party services, forms, and external platforms
* Review business requirements and translate them into scalable, maintainable, and production\-ready technical solutions
* Support architecture decisions related to SSR, CSR, SSG, Headless/Hybrid AEM, client libraries, caching, Dispatcher, and performance optimization
* Troubleshoot complex issues across AEM, frontend bundles, APIs, Dispatcher, Cloud Manager, browser runtime, and deployment pipelines
* Drive best practices around code quality, unit testing, accessibility, SEO, security, Core Web Vitals, and DevOps readiness
* Mentor junior developers and participate actively in code reviews, design discussions, debugging, and technical documentation
* Collaborate with product owners, UX designers, QA engineers, DevOps, analytics teams, and content authors to deliver high\-quality digital experiences
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regard to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications:**

* Must have fulltime graduation degree
* 5\+ years of web application development experience
* 3\+ years of hands\-on AEM development experience with AEM 6\.5 and/or AEM as a Cloud Service
* Solid Java development experience with OSGi, Apache Sling, Sling Models, JCR/Oak, servlets, schedulers, and Maven
* Solid frontend experience with React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, SCSS, and modern frontend build tools
* Experience building AEM components using HTL/Sightly, editable templates, dialogs, client libraries, content policies, and authoring workflows
* Experience with REST API design, JSON data models, third\-party integrations, forms, and API\-driven architecture.  

Hands\-on experience with AEM Headless CMS, including Content Fragments, Content Fragment Models, GraphQL APIs, Experience Fragments, and React/Next.js\-based content consumption patterns
* Familiarity with AEM as a Cloud Service, Cloud Manager, Dispatcher, caching, content publishing, replication, and deployment pipelines
* Experience with Git, Jenkins or similar CI/CD tools, SonarQube, unit testing, code reviews, and Agile delivery
* Solid understanding of Core Web Vitals, accessibility standards, SEO, semantic HTML, browser performance, and responsive development
* Solid troubleshooting, analytical, communication, and problem\-solving skills.

As a forward‑thinking asset manager, we build dynamic relationships with clients, understand their goals, and navigate complex markets together. We leverage cutting‑edge strategies and deep insights to unlock opportunities for long‑term wealth creation. Our talented, global teams bring expertise that is both broad and unique.

  

From our welcoming, inclusive, and supportive culture to our globally diverse business, we offer opportunities not only to help you reach your potential, but also to contribute to our clients’ success.

 ***About the Department:***


The Automation Center of Excellence (CoE) develops and supports Artificial Intelligence (AI) and automation solutions that drive efficiency, productivity, and operational excellence across Franklin Templeton. The team partners with business and technology stakeholders to deliver intelligent solutions using modern automation platforms, AI tools, and reusable frameworks. Team members gain exposure to enterprise\-scale automation programs, emerging AI technologies, and opportunities to solve complex business challenges across multiple functions.

***How You Will Add Value******?***

***Core Responsibilities:***

* You will develop and support intelligent automation solutions using Power Platform, KNIME, Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and other AI\-enabled technologies.

* You will analyze business processes and identify automation opportunities that improve productivity and reduce operational risk.

* You will create technical documentation and support deployment activities.
* You will ensure solutions meet security, scalability, compliance, and quality standards.

***Team \& Collaboration:***

* You will collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, and engineering teams.
* You will participate in Agile planning, reviews, and delivery activities.
* You will share knowledge, best practices, and reusable solutions across teams.

***Production Support \& Continuous Improvement:***

* You will continuously improve automation reliability, maintainability, and performance.
* You will contribute to operational excellence and platform enhancements.

***What Will Help You Be Successful in This Role******?***

***Experience:***

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or related discipline.

jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------



Arcesium is a global financial technology firm that solves complex data\-driven challenges faced by some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions. We constantly innovate our platform and capabilities to meet tomorrow’s challenges, anticipate the risks our clients encounter, and design advanced solutions to help our clients achieve transformational business outcomes.


Financial technology is a high\-growth industry as change and innovation continue to disrupt the status\-quo and prompt major transformation. Arcesium is at a particularly interesting time in our own growth as we look to leverage our successfully established market position and expand operations in pursuit of strategic new business opportunities. We value intellectual curiosity, proactive ownership, and collaboration with colleagues, and we empower you to meaningfully contribute from day one and accelerate your professional development.


Arcesium is a Financial Technology and Professional Services Firm, delivering solutions to some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions, including hedge funds, banks, and institutional asset managers. Expertly designed to achieve a single source of truth throughout a client’s ecosystem, Arcesium’s cloud\-native technology is built to systematize the most complex tasks.



Building on a platform developed and tested by one of the world’s leading investment and technology development firms, the D. E. Shaw group, Arcesium launched as an independent company in 2015\. **About Skyspecs:**  

At SkySpecs, our mission is to simplify renewable asset management so that less can do more for the planet. SkySpecs is helping to make this possible by automating the operations and maintenance of wind farms using advanced robotics paired with our custom\-built asset performance management software, Horizon.
  

  

SkySpecs launched the world's first completely autonomous blade inspection product in 2016 with a custom\-designed drone system. Since then, SkySpecs has inspected over 90% of the US wind turbines and expanded globally, becoming the world leader in understanding the health of turbine blades. Identifying issues with turbine blades is only the first step. In 2019, SkySpecs launched Horizon, a platform for SkySpecs to offer a multi\-layered solution for customers that includes: data collection, wind turbine blade engineering expertise, and a place for all stakeholders to collaborate to manage and analyze massive amounts of data, spot trends, and create plans for high\-cost repair campaigns. In 2021, SkySpecs acquired two companies specializing in wind turbine drivetrain monitoring and financial management, further expanding our asset management portfolio. Ultimately, this will help reduce the cost and risk of operations for the industry.


**What will I be getting myself into?**
---------------------------------------


As a Senior Software Engineer, you will help shape the future of our Horizon platform and the way we build software. Horizon is the platform behind SkySpecs' wind and solar inspection and asset\-management business, and the work is hands\-on, building end\-to\-end.  

  

As the cost of producing code falls, an engineer's impact comes more than ever from judgment, design, and outcomes, not volume. AI is central to how we work here, and we treat it as serious leverage: a force multiplier for engineers who already have strong instincts, not a substitute for them. We expect everyone to keep pushing what AI, automation, and agents make possible, and to bring the judgment that makes that leverage pay off.  

  

We do not separate thinking from doing. You will be expected to independently take broad, highly ambiguous problem statements, formulate scalable technical solutions, and participate directly in delivery by writing and owning production code.  Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen.
   

  

 Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Reporting to the IT\&D Product Group Director Procurement, the IT\&D P2P Product Manager is responsible for owning and driving the Source\-to\-invoice agenda of procurement function.
   

  

 The role ensures clear product vision, roadmap ownership, and strong value delivery, translating business and IT\&D objectives into well defined product outcomes aligned to procurement priorities. This includes shaping product strategy, defining success metrics, prioritising backlogs, and ensuring products are delivered in line with agreed objectives, timelines, and governance standards.
   

  

 Your responsibilities
   

  

* Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for multiple products across the Source to Pay lifecycle (e.g. sourcing, negotiations, contracting).
* Translate Procurement strategy and pain points into high value use cases, balancing innovation with practical business impact.
* Define product success through clear value metrics, KPIs, and adoption measures, ensuring benefits are realised and sustained.
* Lead the end to end product lifecycle: discovery, POCs, MVPs, scaling, and continuous improvement.
* Shape and prioritise the product backlog, working closely with Product Owners, Data Scientists, Data Engineers, AI Engineers, Business Analysts, and Architects.
* Ensure products are designed responsibly, with appropriate consideration for model performance, explainability, data quality, security, and compliance.
* Stay current with technology trends including SAP/Ariba, Analytics, Integration and automation solutions, GenAI, agent based systems, optimisation algorithms, game theory, and decision intelligence, and assess their relevance for Procurement.


 The experience we're looking for
   

  

* 10\+ years of proven experience as a Product Manager delivering digital products.
* Strong Procurement domain knowledge, particularly across the Source to Pay process.
* Expertise in Data concepts and structures, AI and analytics principles and data pipelines (hands on coding not required).
* Experience delivering products in procurement, supply chain, or enterprise functions.
* Experience operating within Agile / product led delivery models.
* Background in transformation, innovation, or advanced analytics programmes.
* Hands\-on experience of SAP/Ariba upstream (sourcing, contracting)
* Solid understanding of digital product lifecycles, including discovery, MVP delivery, scaling, and benefits realisation.


 The skills for success
   

  

 Product Development, Product Management, SAP Ariba, Procurement , Source to Pay, Analytics, Product Life Cycle, Supply Chain, Digital Transformation
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

 With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short\-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
   

  

 Equality
   

  

 We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Applied AI Product Manager**
**Overview**
**Job Description**
 An Applied AI Product Manager is a senior individual contributor responsible for ensuring a product’s value and viability within a product line. This role involves leading empowered, cross\-functional product teams to solve moderate complexity customer problems that align with high value business needs. The Applied AI Product Manager is accountable for the product’s success, from vision to execution, and collaborates closely with various functions and stakeholders to deliver valuable, viable, usable, and feasible solutions. The Applied AI Product Manager harnesses AI and agentic tools to compress the concept\-to\-cash learning loop—automating analysis, prototyping, and compliance detail\-work so the team can focus on the human judgment AI cannot replace: product sense\-making.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Product Accountability
* Responsible and accountable for the product's value and viability showcasing a measurable Return on Investments (ROI)
* Drive strategy\-aligned solutions to achieve product value objectives.
* Formulate and achieve Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for identified problems to solve.
* Measure KPIs and analyze outcomes to inform future strategies.
* Leverage AI to harvest outcome evidence early and often, lowering total cost of ownership (TCO).
* Vision and Strategy
* Co\-create, own, and evangelize the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, using AI to deepen domain knowledge and simulate future scenarios to chart pathways others have not yet seen.
* Align product objectives with the product line and business goals.
* Co\-create in collaboration with business stakeholders, engineering, experience, and delivery.

* Remove obstacles for the team and ensure smooth flow of continuous value achievement.

* 1\+ years of building AI based intelligent products
* 1\+ year’s experience in using GenAI tools to perform product management tasks like conduct idea research, shaping, synthesis, roadmaps, requirements, prototyping, testing


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Preferred Education: An MBA or related advanced degree is preferred.
* Preferred Experience:
* Demonstrated experience in modern product craft of delivering the right thing, in the right way, at the right time. Significant experience in lean product management craft and domain (tools, methods, and practices). Seen as a leader in this space.
* Proven accountability for value, viability and P\&L objectives for a product and for an empowered product team.

jobs.description:
**Company Description**
 Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
   

  

**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
 Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
   

  

 As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
   

  

**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
 More about
 **our mission** 
 and
 **what we offer** 
 .
   

  

**About Wise**
 Wise is building money without borders. Our customers should be able to move, hold, receive, and spend money internationally with a product that is fast, transparent, low\-cost, and safe.
   

  

 Verification is central to that mission. We need to keep financial crime out of Wise, meet regulatory obligations across many markets, and make it easy for legitimate customers to get started and use our products.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Global KYC and Onboarding Squad is improving Wise's KYC and onboarding experience by reducing three things at the same time:
   

  

* Financial crime risk, by making reviews, controls, and decisioning more effective.
* Operational cost, by automating repeatable work and improving how agents handle complex cases.
* Customer friction, by making verification clearer, faster, and easier to complete.


 Business Onboarding Verification focuses on business customers. Businesses are not simple identity objects: they are legal entities connected to directors, shareholders, UBOs, authorised signatories, employees, documents, registry data, vendor data, ownership structures, risk signals, and market\-specific requirements.
   

  

 That makes KYB one of Wise's most complex verification domains. It is also one of the biggest opportunities to improve customer experience, reduce manual work, improve control quality, and build better risk decisioning.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are hiring a Product Manager to own one of the workstreams within Business Onboarding Verification. Each PM within the team owns a complex product area end to end, from discovery and roadmap through delivery, measurement, and iteration.
   

  

 These are not generic AI, programme management, or stakeholder coordination roles. You will coordinate complex work, but the core of the job is product ownership: defining the problem, shaping the solution, making trade\-offs explicit, setting success metrics, launching safely, and ensuring each change improves KYB as a product.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
* Own the product roadmap for one BOV workstream, from discovery through launch and iteration.
* Identify the highest\-value problems using customer friction, operational cost, manual review load, risk impact, regulatory need, and delivery readiness.
* Translate ambiguous KYB problems into clear product requirements, launch criteria, success metrics, and learning loops.
* Partner with Engineering, Analytics/Data Science, Product Compliance, Risk, Operations, regional teams, vendors, support partners, and adjacent PMs.
* Define launch metrics and guardrails across customer impact, manual review load, operational adoption, control quality, false positives, false negatives, auditability, monitoring, and rollback.
* Build feedback loops from agents, QA, assurance, customer outcomes, support contacts, downstream risk signals, and vendor/model performance where relevant.
* Balance tactical delivery with long\-term product foundations.


**What Success Looks Like In The First 6\-12 Months**
* Your workstream has a clear roadmap with explicit priorities and measurable outcomes.
* The team has shipped meaningful product improvements, not just analysis or coordination.
* Product changes are safer to launch because metrics, guardrails, monitoring, fallback paths, and ownership are clear.
* Cross\-functional partners understand what is being solved, why it matters, who owns what, and how success will be measured.
* KYB becomes faster, more measurable, more auditable, and easier for legitimate businesses and agents to navigate.


**This Role Gives You The Opportunity To**
* Work on one of the most important regulated onboarding domains at Wise.
* Improve the experience for business customers and the agents reviewing their cases.
* Build practical AI, automation, decisioning, controls, and platform foundations in a real operational environment.
* Work across Product, Engineering, Compliance, Risk, Operations, Analytics, regional teams, and vendors on high\-stakes problems.
* Shape how Wise moves from fragmented manual review and tactical control work toward reusable, measurable KYB capabilities.


**Qualifications**
**What We Are Looking For**
* You have product management experience owning complex work from discovery through delivery and measurable outcomes.
* You are comfortable in data\-heavy, risk\-sensitive, operational, regulated, onboarding, payments, trust and safety, compliance, or fintech domains.
* You can reason with data and metrics, including denominators, baselines, segmentation, sample bias, data quality, attribution limits, and guardrails.
* You can translate ambiguous product, risk, compliance, or operational problems into clear requirements, launch criteria, and iteration plans.
* You understand that regulated product delivery needs evidence, auditability, operational readiness, monitoring, and ownership.
* You communicate clearly, make trade\-offs explicit, and can create alignment without formal authority.


**Strong Additional Signals**
* Experience in KYB, KYC, business onboarding, financial crime, identity, fraud, risk decisioning, compliance tooling, operational tooling, payments, or regulated fintech.

Role Overview
   

  

 Application
   

  

**Senior Product Manager Location: Hyderabad, India (Hybrid)** 
**About the Company** 
 At Redpin we simplify life's most important payments. Buying a new property overseas can be a stressful time, especially when it comes to moving your money. Through our Currencies Direct and TorFX brands we've been helping people do just that for over 25 years. With recent investment we're now on a mission to build a new range of digital products and services that will make moving money Internationally for Real Estate purchases even easier. We're on a mission to become the solution for Real Estate payments everywhere. To do this, we are transitioning our business from a horizontal FX platform to a verticalized, embedded software company, as we look to the future and Redpin 2\.0\. As part of this mission, we're thrilled to announce we are open a new office in Hyderabad! We're recruiting for several Engineering roles covering front end (React.js) features.
 **About the Role**
* Our Operations teams such as Payment Ops, Compliance Ops, Customer Ops \& treasury Ops have multiple portals and we want to unify all of them. There is no dedicated product owner for stakeholder intake.
* Similarly the Client operations does not have a dedicated product support to capture and identify the issues, prioritize them.


 Currently the platform roadmap is managed informally across multiple teams without clear ownership.
   

  

 We are seeking a Senior Product Manager, Platform to fill this critical gap. This person will be the strategic partner to SRE, Operations and Core Platform Engineering, ensuring the platform runs reliably, the right work gets prioritized, and business stakeholders have a clear intake path.
   

  

**What You Will Do** 
 \- Build a new Admin Tool bringing multiple operations groups together.
 **\- Run the Business Well** 
**\- Manage Intake from Business Teams** 
**\- Define Product Requirements for Core Platform Engineering team** 
**\- Govern Production Data \& Change Control** 
**What You Bring** 
**Required** 
**Preferred**
* Own Site and Platform Reliability Goals
* Define and maintain SLOs (Service Level Objectives) and SLIs (Service Level Indicators) for all customer\-critical flows.
* Stakeholder management \- work with various stakeholders within operations and client facing teams, understand their priorities and needs.
* Translate product expectations into measurable reliability targets that SRE can engineer to.
* Identify and prioritise Top Flows — the highest\-impact user journeys — and ensure they are monitored and protected.
* Lead quarterly reliability reviews with engineering and business stakeholders.
* Own "Keep Lights On" accountability — ensuring operational continuity across Pay Ops, Customer Ops, and Compliance Ops.
* Prioritise the work on the roadmap, making trade\-offs explicit and visible \- all by using data.
* Track live operational health metrics and escalate risks proactively to engineering and business leadership.
* Coordinate incident response communications across stakeholders when SLA thresholds are at risk.
* Serve as the single point of coordination for platform requests from Pay Ops, Customer Ops, and Compliance Ops.
* Run a structured intake process — triage, size, prioritize, and schedule work transparently.
* Reduce ad\-hoc requests and unplanned interruptions to SRE engineering capacity.
* Maintain a visible backlog that business stakeholders can track and trust.
* Author clear functional and non\-functional requirements for platform features and infrastructure investments.
* Partner with Core Platform Engineering to ensure requirements are feasible, scoped, and well\-accepted.
* Define and track success metrics for platform feature launches.
* Build and maintain a product roadmap that aligns platform investment with business priorities.
* Own the end\-to\-end process for authorizing access to production data and approving production changes.
* Balance operational agility with compliance and risk requirements.
* Work with Compliance Ops to ensure change control processes meet regulatory requirements.
* Maintain audit trails and documentation for production change approvals.

* Strong understanding of how operational processes and tools work, understanding various operational workflows.
* Strong understanding of SRE principles: SLOs, SLIs, error budgets, incident management, and on\-call operations.
* Proven ability to translate technical complexity into clear business requirements and executive communications.
* Experience working with cross\-functional stakeholders in regulated or compliance\-sensitive environments.
* Demonstrated ability to build and manage a prioritized product backlog under competing demands.
* Background in fintech, payments, or other high\-availability, high\-compliance environments.
* Experience running incident retrospectives and problem management processes.
* MBA or engineering degree — or equivalent hands\-on experience.

 Arcesium is a Financial Technology and Professional Services Firm, delivering solutions to some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions, including hedge funds, banks, and institutional asset managers. Expertly designed to achieve a single source of truth throughout a client’s ecosystem, Arcesium’s cloud\-native technology is built to systematize the most complex tasks.

Morgan made a strategic investment in the company.  Arcesium's Personal Data Privacy Notice for Candidates is linked here.

jobs.title: Manager, Program Management, Brand Protection
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Are you passionate about protecting the world's most recognized brands and ensuring customers can shop with confidence on Amazon? Join the Intellectual Property Protections (IPP) team — the central hub for addressing complex brand protection challenges across Amazon's global marketplace.  

  

The IPP team designs and builds high\-performance systems leveraging machine learning and cross\-functional collaboration to identify, prevent, and remediate intellectual property abuse on behalf of rights owners worldwide. As the single\-threaded owner for end\-to\-end brand protection solutions, IPP ingests and prioritizes critical brand pain points, conducts comprehensive root cause analysis, develops sustainable mechanisms, and drives continuous improvement across Amazon's brand protection ecosystem.  

  

We are seeking a strategic, experienced Manager, Program Management to lead a team of program managers responsible for the strategy, execution, and cross\-organizational integration of Brand Protection programs. This is a hybrid people\-leadership and program\-delivery role and you will own the performance, growth, and delivery output of your team while individually driving high\-impact programs that turn reactive enforcement into proactive, scalable prevention, directly reducing brand abuse for rights owners globally.  

  

This role operates in ambiguous, cross\-functional environments where problem definition and strategy are not always predetermined. You will shape the direction of your team's work, define what success looks like, and build the organizational capability to deliver with senior leadership visibility.  

  

This is a global role requiring effective communication and understanding of the diverse needs of international brands, operational teams, and stakeholders across countries.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

1\. Lead and develop a team of program managers, setting clear expectations, providing direct and constructive feedback, and coaching each team member to operate at the top of their level.  

2\. Build a high\-performing team culture centered on ownership, bias for action, and customer obsession fostering an environment where PgMs can tackle ambiguous, high\-stakes problems independently.  

3\. Establish team\-level mechanisms (e.g., weekly business reviews, program health checks, retrospectives) that drive operational rigor and continuous improvement.  

4\. Develop and execute comprehensive strategies to address complex, high\-ambiguity brand protection challenges, owning the most critical and cross\-cutting programs.  

5\. Analyze defect trends, abuse patterns, policy gaps, and process inefficiencies to design scalable mechanisms that support evolving business needs and strengthen Amazon's enforcement posture.  

6\. Establish key mechanisms, dashboards, and self\-service tooling that eliminate manual dependencies and enhance Amazon's brand protection capabilities at scale.  

7\. Lead cross\-functional initiatives spanning Product, Engineering, Operations, Science, and Policy teams across multiple geographies, operating as a thought leader in the IP protection space.  

8\. Influence roadmap prioritization across multiple organizations making trade\-off recommendations, surfacing the right inputs for leadership decisions, and ensuring your team's programs are integrated into the broader Brand Protection strategy.  

9\. Author and present program updates to senior leadership, translating complex cross\-org dependencies into crisp narratives and actionable decision points.  

10\. Build and maintain deep team\-level expertise in brand abuse and enforcement strategy, ensuring the team can conduct rigorous deep dives to derive insights about emerging abuse vectors across Amazon's worldwide stores.  

  

About the team  

The vision of Intellectual Property Protections (IPP) team is to ensure every Brand’s catalog (ASINs and offers) is clean with no IP infringements while minimizing friction for the Sellers. We do this by proactively identifying infringing content on ASINs and offers through various signals including Brand provided data, Seller behavior, Brand licensee relationships, Brand/Seller appeals, etc. We build highly transparent systems that communicate the impact of our protections clearly and unambiguously to the Brand Owner and earn their trust.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of cross functional project delivery experience
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 5\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* Experience managing teams

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership
* Master's degree
* Knowledge of SQL

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.
   

  

 At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision\-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.
   

  

**Associate Product Data Manager \- Private Markets Content**
 We’re looking for a Product Data Manager / Owner to join our team of software and AI/ML engineers as we build out a future\-ready company data foundation.
   

  

 Our team lives within the Content Refinery unit which provides the most comprehensive and connected inventory of client, proprietary and third\-party content in the industry. The Content Refinery produces a suite of connected content with extensive data hierarchy and taxonomy. Our team represents the company data master which is leveraged by our internal partners to build next\-generation workflows for our clients.
   

  

 You’ll be joining the Entity Intelligence Team which is responsible for defining, collecting, and building modern systems to curate data via agent\-led processes, 3rd\-party data and other internal FactSet teams. This data powers the products that all FactSet clients use to analyze their investments in Private Companies (e.g., sourcing, due diligence, and fundraising).
   

  

**Role Description**
 As the Product Data Manager, you will convert business strategy and client needs into the vision that powers our data and a product roadmap and work closely with our AI/ML Engineering teams, Claude (and other AI tooling) and legacy systems to execute on that roadmap.
   

  

 You will work with internal stakeholders to understand the content expansions that will create the most impact for our clients and then translate them into the overall vision. You will then help break down the vision into a roadmap of themes, epics, stories, bugs, and acceptance criteria. That overall vision will guide our AI/ML team in building the models and pipelines that identify and structure this content to make the most impact for clients.
   

  

**Responsibilities**

* Translate stakeholder needs into a backlog of work to be refined into user stories that state the functional expectations and reasoning for how it impacts our clients.

**Tracking Progress Of Your Work**
* Define and report metrics to provide transparency for progress against the product roadmap.
* Surface or anticipate hidden project risks and develop contingency plans to mitigate those risks.
* Synchronize with other product owners and internal team leads to identify obstacles and dependencies, working to remove them through negotiation and escalation.
* Communicate with Stakeholders, other Product Owners, and Engineering teams to ensure the vision and goals for Private Markets Content is understood. Ensure buy\-in is achieved on all major decisions.


**Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of data product management experience on a data team or similar role managing content data sets.
* Team player attitude with a strong desire to learn about Private Markets, modern data tooling and matrix organization structures.
* A keen interest to learn from and work with engineers to apply AI/ML to real world data.
* A solid understanding of financial valuation
+ Understand and derive Market valuations: e.g., identify peer groups, market multiples, industry betas, capital structures, and business models for various groups of industries.
+ Use or derive financial models, vendor data (FactSet, etc) and/ormarket research to assess viability and growth potential of private companies

* General knowledge of data environments (warehouses, lakes, pipelines, mapping, ETLs...).
* Analytical skills and data driven mindset that can be hands\-on when needed with data analysis (Excel, PowerQuery, PowerBI, SQL)


 Highly Desired
   

  

* Experience in Agile software development, working directly with software and data science engineers
* Financial analysis and financial modeling skills: adept at reviewing and parsing financial statements e.g. income statement, balance sheet, and statement of cash flows
* Experience with structured transactions, banking, consulting, analytical experience in a specific industry.
* Experience in due diligence, have a view on a company. Invest/Not Invest, identifying potential acquisition targets for large corporations
* Comfortable with ambiguity and dynamic environments while understanding process and constraints of a large organization.
* Ability to make decisions quickly and remove ambiguity for the team to help them move faster.

At Quickbase, we help organizations build better ways to run their operations. Our products give teams the flexibility to create applications around how their work actually happens, connecting people, information, and processes so they can keep work moving as needs change.
  

  

For more than 25 years, organizations have turned to Quickbase to solve operational challenges that off\-the\-shelf software wasn't built for. Today, we’re building on that foundation with new products and new possibilities for how people create, adapt, and improve the systems their work depends on.
  

  

Working at Quickbase means helping find better ways forward. We’re a team of curious, collaborative people who care about solving problems, learning as we go, and building things that make work better for our customers and each other.


**Senior Data Analyst, Operational Intelligence**

The person in this seat has an outsized influence on that.


The ideal candidate is an expert SQL and data modeling practitioner who is equally comfortable being handed an ambiguous business problem and a blank page. * Partner closely with Data Engineering on pipeline dependencies, data quality practices, and modeling standards, and act as the informed voice of the business when trade\-offs need to be made.
* Support operating mechanisms including GTM business reviews, weekly forecast reviews, and state of the business reporting, where accuracy and timeliness are non\-negotiable.
* Build self\-service foundations by producing reusable, well\-documented datasets and semantic models that let stakeholders answer their own recurring questions.

* Mentor other analysts and contribute to the technical growth of the Operational Intelligence team.

jobs.description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full\-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision \- to simplify payments for Indian businesses \- we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.
   

  

 Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
   

  

 From building AI\-native agentic payments, to AI\-assisted fraud detection and real\-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners \- including banks, networks, regulators \- we are pioneering industry\-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
   

  

 Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation \- powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
   

  

 Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early\-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
   

  

 Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180\+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme \- and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
   

  

 We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India \& SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions \- including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards\-first UPI) \- along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
   

  

 But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen \- you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle \- if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People \> Pedigree \- we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles \- this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy \& Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000\+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
   

  

**The Role:** 
 As a PM2, you will independently own a product area or platform charter end\-to\-end — from strategy and roadmap to execution and business impact. You will operate with significant autonomy and drive initiatives across customer experience, platform scalability, automation, growth, and monetization. You will be expected to think beyond features and solve for systems, operational leverage, and long\-term platform evolution.
   

  

**What you’ll do?**
* Build Customer Empathy \- Regularly engage with customers, internal stakeholders, and ecosystem partners to deeply understand pain points, workflows, and unmet needs through both qualitative and quantitative insights.
* Drive Product Strategy \- Define long\-term product vision and quarterly roadmap aligned with business goals, customer outcomes, and platform scalability.
* Build Scalable Products \- Collaborate with engineering, design, analytics, and operations teams to build reliable, scalable, and high\-impact products.
* Lead Product Execution \- Write high\-quality product specifications, prioritize effectively, manage tradeoffs, and ensure timely execution across releases
* Own Metrics \& Outcomes \- Define success metrics, monitor business impact, and driveiterative improvements through experimentation and data analysis.
* Ecosystem Collaboration \- Partner with banks, regulators, vendors, and ecosystem players to co\-build industry\-defining solutions.


**What are we looking for?**
* 4–7 years of product management experience
* Strong product execution and prioritization skills
* Experience owning business metrics and customer outcomes
* Strong analytical thinking and experimentation mindset
* Ability to work across technical and business stakeholders
* Systems thinking and platform orientation
* Strong customer empathy balanced with business acumen
* Ability to thrive in ambiguity and fast\-paced environments

Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values different voices and lifts each other up. Here, we believe your unique perspective is
   

  

 important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful.
   

  

**Team Overview**
 Right along with Target’s distinctive retail brand, we are constantly improving and innovating our digital shopping experience. Are you ready to excel in the fast\-changing retail environment? Are you a customer service enthusiast who’s curious about the guest and can see the shopping journey through their eyes? Then you’ll have success on the Digital Strategy \& Platform team, whose goal is to offer guests a seamless online shopping experience across our platforms—including Target.com and the store network’s fulfillment capabilities. Here, you’ll collaborate to create and implement the digital strategies that enrich the online experience through the right mix of personalization, simplicity and intuitiveness.  You will encourage the open exchange of information and viewpoints, as well as inspire others to achieve challenging goals and high standards of performance while committing to the organization's direction. You will foster sense of urgency to achieve goals and leverage resources to overcome unexpected obstacles.

**About The Job**
 At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
   

  

 In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.
   

  

 One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.
   

  

 Geo Makers extends Geo’s mission by empowering millions of businesses and developers with real world platforms and solutions that help people explore, navigate and get things done in the real world. We do this by exposing various APIs collectively called Google Maps Platform (GMP). The customers use us in both Business\-to\-Consumer (B2C) (e.g. schedule a ride, locate a store or find your next vacation) and Business\-to\-Business (B2B) (manage a fleet of trucks, or assess insurance risk) contexts.
   

  

 The Geo team is focused on building the most accurate, comprehensive, and useful maps for our users, through products like Maps, Earth, Street View, Google Maps Platform, and more. Every month, more than a billion people rely on Maps services to explore the world and navigate their daily lives.
   

  

 The Geo team also enables developers to use the power of Google Maps platforms to enhance their apps and websites. As they plot a course for the future of mapping, they are solving complex computer science problems, designing beautiful and intuitive product experiences, and improving our understanding of the real world.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Define the product goal, strategy and roadmap for the overall Map Intelligence Area, including our Maptrics platform, Insights Agents, and broader efforts supporting the emerging markets data needs.

jobs.description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise\-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet\-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Part Of**
 Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.
   

  

 What you'll be responsible for
   

  

 You will own product areas within Managed Payments, Circle’s regulated payments infrastructure that enables PSPs, financial institutions, banks, and enterprises to use stablecoin\-powered payment rails without operating crypto infrastructure themselves. You will define and evolve product capabilities that support managed pay\-ins, payouts, conversion, and transaction lifecycle management across stablecoin and fiat endpoints. Working closely with Engineering, Compliance, Operations, Treasury, and commercial teams, you will translate complex customer and business needs into clear product priorities, lead cross\-functional execution, and deliver measurable improvements to how customers move money across geographies and payment rails.
   

  

 What you'll work on
   

  

* Own the roadmap for product areas across managed pay\-ins, payouts, fiat endpoints, conversion, and transaction lifecycle management, aligning priorities with customer needs and Circle’s goals.
* Define and launch capabilities that expand Managed Payments across Circle’s regulated hubs, including new entities, corridors, payout methods, and geographic coverage.
* Shape simple, reliable customer experiences for accepting funds, converting value, and disbursing globally across stablecoin and fiat rails, including integrations with CPN and other Circle systems.
* Improve customer and operator workflows across onboarding, account setup, transaction visibility, reporting, exception handling, reconciliation, refunds, RFIs, and bulk payments.
* Use customer, product, payment, and operational data to identify friction, prioritize investments, and measure improvements in reliability, efficiency, adoption, and customer experience.
* Evaluate opportunities to support new payment rails, payout use cases, and digital assets based on customer demand, regulatory requirements, technical feasibility, and business priorities.
* Lead complex cross\-functional initiatives with Engineering, Compliance, Operations, Legal, Treasury, BD, and Product, navigating technical and business trade\-offs and driving alignment from definition through launch.


 What you'll bring to Circle
   

  

 Core requirements
   

  

* 4\+ years of relevant experience, including product management experience building payments, fintech, financial infrastructure, or similarly complex B2B products.
* Experience owning product vision, roadmaps, and execution for B2B capabilities such as payments, pay\-ins, payouts, settlement, treasury infrastructure, APIs, or financial operations.

jobs.description:
**About The Team**
 Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e\-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers \- ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.
   

  

 Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us. 😉
   

  

 We are driven by a ‘user\-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ \& delivery \- not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.
   

  

 But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs, to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who is passionate about solving high impact problems in a fast paced start\-up environment with a high degree of autonomy. This is inherently a cross\-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as software engineering, UX design, category mgmt., marketing, operations, finance, etc to bring a new product to life.
   

  

**What Will You Do**
* Market \& Customer Understanding: Understand the e\-commerce market and needs of customers/sellers deeply through landscape analysis, customer interviews, user research, competition analysis and other qualitative/quantitative techniques.
* Problem Identification \& Prioritization: Adopt a structured approach to identify what problems need to be solved and break them down into smaller chunks. Prioritize what problems need to be solved now vs. later.
* Solution Discovery: Facilitate a process to come up with the best technology\-led ideas to solve the prioritized problems. Harness the creativity of not just yourself but of other teams such as design, engg., business, etc. Be willing to experiment with multiple solution ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc.
* Product Delivery: Define detailed product requirements and work collaboratively with a cross\-functional team (design, engineering, business, analytics, etc.) to bring a product to life. Ensure high product quality through processes such as user acceptance testing, dogfooding, etc.
* Go\-to\-Market Planning: Create a go\-to\-market plan working with business/marketing stakeholders to maximize product adoption and success.
* Adoption \& Metrics: Define product metrics for your area, and track them continuously. Identify usage patterns and come up with action plans to move metrics in the right direction.
* Roadmap Creation: Create a product roadmap for your area that has at least a 3\-month forward looking view of key customer/business problems to be solved.
* Team Leadership: Manage a small team of product analysts and associate product managers, and guide them towards product execution.


**What You Will Need**
* Overall experience of 7\+ yrs with atleast 4\+ yrs in product management in a tech\-led company (consumer internet space is preferred)
* Exceptional problem solving skills based on first principles thinking
* Good understanding of technology, and comfort with product management processes such as A/B experimentation, writing product requirement documents, managing product backlogs, and creating roadmaps

Back
   

  

 We are seeking a seasoned Technical Product Owner to guide the evolution of our high\-traffic Sports and News mobile applications, working in close partnership with the Product Owner. This role is pivotal in bridging the gap between business objectives, user needs, and technical execution, with a primary focus on backend systems and APIs. A core responsibility will be empowering our Scrum teams by meticulously refining user stories related to these backend components, ensuring they are clear, concise, and fully prepared for development sprints, thereby maximizing team velocity and product quality.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Product Vision \& Roadmap Collaboration: Collaborate with the Product Owner and product leadership to define and articulate the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Sports and News mobile applications, ensuring alignment with company goals and technical feasibility.
* Backlog Management \& Prioritization (Backend Focus): In partnership with the Product Owner, manage, maintain, and prioritize the product backlog for the mobile apps, with a specific focus on backend services, APIs, and their integration with the mobile front\-end. Ensure the backlog is transparent, well\-understood, and reflects the highest value opportunities.
* Story Refinement \& Readiness (Backend \& API Emphasis): Lead and facilitate rigorous backlog refinement sessions, particularly for backend\-focused user stories, with the Scrum development team (engineers, QA, designers). This includes:
* Breaking down epics and larger features related to backend systems and APIs into granular, well\-defined user stories.
* Clearly articulating functional requirements, technical specifications, and user needs for backend services.
* Defining precise, testable acceptance criteria for API endpoints and backend logic.
* Ensuring all backend stories meet the team's agreed\-upon "Definition of Ready" (DoR) before sprint planning, minimizing ambiguity and enabling efficient development.
* Technical Liaison \& API Definition: Act as the primary technical point of contact for the mobile development team and backend engineering teams, translating business requirements into actionable technical tasks for APIs and services, and providing necessary context. Contribute to the design and definition of new APIs and backend services, ensuring they are scalable, reliable, and meet the functional and non\-functional requirements of the mobile applications.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Engage with various stakeholders, including the Product Owner, business units, editorial teams, marketing, and UX/UI designers, to gather requirements, solicit feedback, and ensure alignment. Act as a key liaison between the Product Owner and the engineering teams for backend initiatives.
* Agile Process Facilitation: Actively participate in all Scrum ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Daily Stand\-ups, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives), providing ongoing clarification and support to the team, especially regarding backend and API implementations.
* Quality Assurance Support (Backend \& API): Work closely with QA to ensure test ability of backend features and API integrations, and validate that implemented solutions meet acceptance criteria.
* Performance Monitoring (Backend Systems): Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to backend service health, API response times, and data integrity, as well as user feedback, to inform future iterations and identify areas for improvement.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3\+ years of experience in a Product Owner, Technical Product Manager, or similar role, with a significant portion focused on backend systems or API development within mobile application contexts.
* Proven experience working within an Agile/Scrum framework, with a strong emphasis on backlog grooming and story refinement techniques, particularly for backend services.
* Demonstrated ability to write clear, concise, and comprehensive user stories and acceptance criteria for backend functionalities and APIs.
* Solid understanding of the mobile application development lifecycle (iOS and/or Android) and how it interfaces with backend systems.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Experience with backlog management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence).
* Analytical mindset with a passion for data\-driven decision\-making.
* Preferred Qualifications:
* Experience working on high\-volume consumer\-facing applications, particularly in the Sports or News media domain.
* Technical background or a strong understanding of mobile technologies, RESTful APIs, microservices, and system integrations.
* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar Agile certification.


**What We Offer**
* Competitive salaries and comprehensive health benefits
* Flexible work hours and remote work options
* Professional development and training opportunities
* A supportive and inclusive work environment
* Access to cutting\-edge technology and tools.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About DPDzero** 




 DPDzero (www.dpdzero.com) is an AI Collections Company for financial institutions to run collections on autopilot. Our AI platform combines digital nudges, AI voice agents, and ethical human interventions to improve borrower experience, maximise recovery and reduce cost.
 



 Trusted by industry leaders like IndusInd Bank, L\&T Finance, Tata Capital, Moneyview, Paysense, and others to manage collections from over 1 crore borrowers in India. Backed by GMO VenturePartners, Blume Ventures, India Quotient, and SMBC Asia Rising Fund.
 



  





**What this role is really about** 




 This role isn't about grooming a backlog, shipping features, or reviewing dashboards. You'll own the telecalling product end to end: its productivity, contactability, conversion, quality, and unit economics, and run it like the business\-critical engine it is
 



 .You're not joining to build another dialer. You're joining to build the operating system that will define how telecalling is done over the next decade.
 



  





**Your mission** 



* **Own the engin** 
 e. Own the productivity, contactability, and collections of the telecalling product. Think like an operator who owns a number, not a PM who ships features.
* **Build the advisor's cockpi** 
 t. Design the workbench, workflows, and in\-call guidance that make every advisor minute count.
* **Make the calling stack reliabl** 
 e. Partner with engineering so outbound, inbound, and automated calling connects, routes, and recovers without losing capacity.
* **Decide who to call nex** 
 t. Turn borrower behaviour and contactability into intelligent queues that maximise productive conversations, not call volume.
* **Put AI on every cal** 
 l. Surface borrower context and next\-best\-action, and bring real\-time and post\-call assistance to the floor.
* **Build quality i** 
 n. Make compliant flows, consent, audit trails, and automated evaluation part of the product, not a manual process bolted on.
* **Turn data into collection** 
 s. Find the opportunities hidden inside millions of calls, and prove every win with a holdout, not an assertion.



  





**You'll love this role if you get excited by questions like:** 



* Why do two borrowers with identical profiles pick up for one advisor and ghost another?
* Should AI call this borrower before a human does, or write the human's opening line?
* Can one change to the queue recover an hour of lost capacity across an entire floor?
* Can a smarter workflow lift collections per advisor without adding a single headcount?
* How do we build India's smartest telecalling engine?



  





**If those excite you more than yesterday's dashboards, you'll probably love it here.** 




  





**What you bring** 




**The non\-negotiables first:** 



* Owned an operational product, workflow, or funnel end to end, at scale. Real ownership, past tense, not adjacent involvement.
* Command of unit economics and operating metrics. You author cost\-per\-outcome logic; you don't wait to receive targets.
* Holdout and experiment discipline. You treat impact as measured, not claimed.
* Dual\-audience range. You earn an ops floor's trust fast, and you're safe in front of enterprise (FI)



  





**Stakeholders and ideally:** 



* 4 to 6 years in product, having independently owned a complex product or platform.
* Deep partnership with engineering on technical systems and integrations.
* Experience with operations heavy products.
* Genuine excitement about using AI to solve real operational problems.



  





**Why DPDzero** 




 This isn't another product role. You'll work directly with collections leaders, operation and data science teams and engineers to build the operating system powering the next generation of telecalling. Instead of shipping features onto yesterday's process, you'll define tomorrow's.

Introduction \- The Strategic Value of the GCC Product Owner
   

  

 The recruitment of Product Owners is an important milestone in the organization's journey toward sustainable, global innovation. By generalizing the role while tailoring it to the specific technological and cultural nuances of the company, the organization aims to attract top\-tier talent capable of driving the next generation of DAM solutions.
   

  

 The Product Owner acts as the cornerstone of the squad, ensuring that the strategic vision of global Product Managers is translated into valuable capabilities and enterprise\-grade code. This requires a unique blend of technical authority, agile mastery, and a commitment to the "Bynder Operating Principles?.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Bynder?s mission is to inspire brands to thrive through exceptional content experiences. As a Product Owner, you will be at the heart of this mission. This role is not just about managing assets; it is about building the foundational technology that allows the world?s most recognizable brands to conquer the complexity and chaos of proliferating content.
   

  

 The Product Owner serves as the tactical engine for a cross\-functional agile squad, working in close collaboration with Engineers, Designers, and Product Managers. This is an execution\-focused role where the individual represents the voice of the customer within the development team, ensuring that user needs are understood and addressed through high\-quality product increments. By fostering an environment of transparent communication and continuous improvement, the Product Owner drives the team toward maximizing value delivery and supporting the organization's global success.
   

  

 What You'll Be Doing to Drive Impact
   

  

* Own the Backlog: Translate the high\-level strategic vision and roadmap provided by Product Managers into actionable requirements and user stories. Maintain and prioritize a healthy backlog that aligns with strategic goals and enterprise\-grade standards.
* Act as the Engineering Sparring Partner: Serve as the primary point of contact for the engineering team on all product\-related questions. Confidently discuss the ?why? of the capabilities that are being developed, discuss technical trade\-offs, and challenge proposals to ensure every development is optimized for value delivery, performance, scalability, and security.
* Set priorities for development cycles: Facilitate sprint planning sessions to set clear objectives and determine priorities for development cycles.
* Ensure Quality and Reliability: Identify and mitigate technical debt, edge cases, and potential failure points within your platform area. Inspect the product increments produced by the team, validating they meet established acceptance criteria and deliver the intended business value.
* Bridge the Communication Gap: Act as the key liaison between the development team and internal stakeholders. Effectively communicate product goals, progress, and technical complexities to both technical and non\-technical audiences, ensuring alignment across the global product organization.
* Drive Continuous Improvement: Actively seek and provide constructive feedback to facilitate the team?s growth. Leverage data\-driven insights to make informed decisions and take calculated risks that challenge the status quo.
